description.en:
Before the release of The Irregular at Magic High School - Yotsuba Succession Arc in theatres on Friday, May 8th, 2026, here is a manga compilation that lets you look back at the entire Mahouka anime series all at once!

As long as you read this, you’ll be able to enjoy the movie The Irregular at Magic High School: Yotsuba Succession Arc right away!

Let’s take a look back at the Mahouka anime together with the Shiba siblings!
description.ja:
この1冊で追いつける！
魔法科高校の劣等生
5月8日（金）公開の劇場版「魔法科高校の劣等生 四葉継承編」の前に
これまでのアニメ「魔法科」シリーズを一挙に振り返ることができる漫画コンテンツ。
これさえ読んでいればすぐに劇場版「魔法科高校の劣等生 四葉継承編」をお楽しみいただけます！
あなたも司波兄妹と一緒にアニメ魔法科を振り返っていきましょう！！

description.en:
Yotsuba is a strange little girl with a big personality! Even in the most trivial, unremarkable encounters, Yotsuba's curiosity and enthusiasm quickly turns the everyday into the extraordinary!

---
- **Won the Excellence Award for Manga at the Japan Media Arts Festival in 2006**


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media (2007)
description.ru:
Повседневная жизнь Ёцубы Койвай полна приключений. Она активная, любопытная и немного эксцентричная девочка. Настолько эксцентричная, что её отец прозвал её странной и несведущей в вещах, которые должны знать даже пятилетки. Из-за этого самое простое событие для неё становится настоящим приключением. Проходят дни, Ёцуба заводит новых друзей и показывает всем на личном примере, что каждый день может быть в радость.

---

(Source: [shikimori](https://shikimori.one/mangas/104-yotsuba-to))
description.tr:
Yotsuba, tuhaf ve eğlenceli bir kişiliğe  sahip küçük bir kız!

Gün içindeki sıradan, önemsiz olaylarda bile merakı ve coşkusuyla o günü sıradışı yapıyor!
description.uk: Йоцуба — це маленьке дивне дівча з великою особистістю! Її ім’я з японської означає "чотирилиста конюшина", цьому також відповідає форма та колір її волосся. Але чи значить це, що вона приносить тільки удачу? Хтозна... зрозуміло одне: з цією дівчинкою ніколи не знудишся, бо вона швидко перетворює щось буденне на екстраординарне!
description.pt-br: Novas pessoas chegam nas grandes cidades todos os dias. Porém, dessa vez é uma pessoa diferente das normais: Yotsuba e seu pai. Eles se mudam para a capital e logo conheceremos a garotinha de cabelos verdes, seu pai e toda a vizinhança. Mas será que eles realmente são uma família comum? Acompanhe Yotsubato e descubra que a normalidade depende do ponto de vista de quem olha.

description.en:
In December, Miyuki receives an invitation for the Yotsuba's new year's family gathering. However, unlike previous years, they specially added "Everyone must attend" on the invitation. Miyuki understands that "the time has come" — it is time to decide the next head for the Yotsuba Clan.  
— If she is elected, her brother will be free.  
— If she becomes the next head, she will be forced to marry someone else.  
Miyuki's heart is a mess.  
The truth of the Brother and Sister relationship is finally unveiled!? Yotsuba Keishou-hen begins!  
  
Adaptation of the original novel's volume 16.

description.en:
Located in the north, south, east, and west, just like flower petals.  
Those four kingdoms that border each other are known as “The Four Blossoms”  
  
In each of these four kingdoms, there are saints who are called as “Butterflies of the Four Blossoms”  
  
The Butterfly of the West, Carnelia is about to visit the Southern Kingdom for the first time as her duty.  
  
What awaits her there, is…..

description.en:
Continuation of "Motoyan Papa to Hitsuji-sensei"  
  
Hitsuji, an elementary school teacher, became lovers with his first love from high school, Hatoyama. They now enjoy their days while taking care of Hatoyama’s son, Hinata.  
  
But now that Hinata is in his third year, Hitsuji won’t be his teacher anymore, and instead, his new teacher is Samejima-sensei.  
  
Hitsuji, who is full of worries and anxieties has a lot to think of.

description.ar: كان يويتشي محبوبًا في السابق، لكنه الآن يتعرض للتنمر بشكل مفرط. وفجأة، تظهر أمامه حبيبته الأولى يوتسُوها. ما هدف هذه الفتاة اللطيفة والشجاعة…؟
description.en: Uichi was once popular, but now he is being bullied excessively. Then suddenly, his first love, Yotsuha, appears in front of him. What is this cute and brave girl's purpose…?
description.ja: かつての人気者で、今は過激ないじめを受ける宇一。そんな彼の前に突然現れた初恋の相手・よつは。可愛く健気な彼女の目的とは一体…！？
description.vi: Câu chuyện romcom nhẹ nhàng về hành trình chữa lành trái tim đã tan vỡ của main
description.zh: 某天，曾很有人气的宇一的生活陡然一变。 以往光芒四射的日子被用抹布也无法擦去的黑暗所笼罩。 这时，熟悉宇一过去的初恋—— 四叶突然出现在了他的面前。 她的目的究竟是…！？
description.pt-br: Uichi já foi um garoto popular e deseja ser um veterinário, porém com o passar do tempo virou alvo de bullying. Então, quando tudo estava sendo horrível, de repente, seu primeiro amor, Yotsuba, aparece em sua frente. Qual será o objetivo dessa linda e corajosa garota que não aparecia a 7 anos?
